title: Mi terreno
about: The land's steps (Y11, D-game-32): a checklist shown from play session 2 that never holds sleep back and does not end a session. stake: the player held the stake (the mayor gives it for free, villager.give_stake; the step counts the bag, and one more once the plot is owned: the mayor keeps the stake at the purchase, Y15, so the step stays done with the bag empty of it, after a load too). buy: the plot is bought from the mayor (his sell_plot raises plot_bought); a loaded game reads it from the save's land entry (systems.land.owned). While a plot is marked and not bought the arrow points at the mayor, after the purchase at the plot. camp (Y12): the camp kit has set up the tent, the bedroll and the fire ring on the plot (camp_placed; a loaded game reads it from the save's camp, systems.sleep.camp). fire: a torch is on the placed ring (fire_lit with the detail camp.fire; a loaded game reads the ring from the world). Packing the camp back into the kit does not undo a step in the same run; a load reads the camp as it then stands.
